title: UPPLAND ottoman with storage
description: UPPLAND ottoman with storage, Kilanda light beige Comfortable to rest your feet on or to use as extra seating and it has a practical storage space under the seat. The cover is easy to keep clean since it is removable and can be machine washed.
materialAndCare: Seat frame: Particleboard, Plywood, Solid wood, Fiberboard, Melamine foil; Seat cushion: Polyurethane foam 2.0 lb/cu.ft.; Smolder resistant lining: Polyester wadding; Fabric: 100% polyester (min. 90% recycled); Cord: 100 % polyester
